source: Create a game in which we can climb a building and have fun by jumping from top floor with other playres

image_prompt.text: A chain of platforms wrapping the building floor by floor, spaced to the jump limits, giving an ordered climbing route to the roof
Platforms on the climb that vanish a set time after being stepped on
Trusses, ladders and wall scrambles up the outside of the building
An open rooftop payoff area at the top of the climb
A tall multi-storey building with distinct floors, standing in an open area

layout_placement.text: The rooftop reward area where the climb ends and the jump begins
A landing area at the base of the building for players jumping off the top floor

notes: Tower Obby preset taken whole; obstacle-timing and the reward half of winner-zone are preset contributions the prompt never asked for.
The prompt's payoff is leaping off the roof with other players, which the genre has no option for — the rooftop is treated as winner-zone and the landing area carried as free text.

open_questions.ask: What should the building look like — a modern city high-rise, a stylized cartoon tower, something else?
Is the climb a challenge you can fail, or can players get to the roof freely and the jumping is the whole game?
Do players climb the outside of the building, or go up through floors and stairwells inside?

coverage_missing.ask: What should the building look like?
Is the climb something you can fail, or is getting up freely the point?
Climb the outside of the building, or go up through the inside?
Should the ground catch the fall — water, trampolines, soft terrain — or is falling meant to kill you?

answers.ask: What should the building look like — a modern city high-rise, a stylized cartoon tower, something else?
answers.answer: Make it a modern city high-rise.

answers.ask: Is the climb a challenge you can fail, or can players get to the roof freely and the jumping is the whole game?
answers.answer: The climb should be a simple challenge players can fail, then they can jump from the roof for fun with other players.

answers.ask: Do players climb the outside of the building, or go up through floors and stairwells inside?
answers.answer: Players should climb the outside of the building.
